metadata.case_name: CHUNG HOI KIN v. CHOI SHUN YIN AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_after: transponder operator (training at Tsing Yi Container Terminal); part-time packing worker at Tai Hing Catering Group (from 10 December 2012)

injuries.description: 50% cut of the peroneus longus muscle of the right leg.
source: 50% cut of the peroneus longus and gastrocnemius muscles of the right leg.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple muscles, fasciae or tendons at lower leg level

injuries.description: 50% cut of the gastrocnemius muscle of the right leg.
source: 50% cut of the peroneus longus and gastrocnemius muscles of the right leg.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple muscles, fasciae or tendons at lower leg level

injuries.description: Laceration of the right sural nerve with tissue loss which was found to be beyond repair.
source: the right sural nerve was found to be lacerated with tissue loss which was found to be beyond repair.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of cutaneous sensory nerve at lower leg level

injuries.description: A 10 cm laceration over the postero-lateral side of his right leg.
source: a 10 cm laceration over the postero-lateral side of his right leg.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of lower leg

manifestations.description: episodic feeling of imbalance while walking on level ground
on and off right leg pain on rising up from continuous sitting for half an hour
right leg soreness after prolonged walking for 45 minutes
spontaneous pain over the left scar which sometimes causes transient muscle cramps
right leg pain after running or after strenuous activities
tightness in the posterior right leg when stretches his leg with knee extended
weakness in ankle when performing ankle movement with toes pointing downwards and upwards
numbness felt over a localized area in the right leg beneath the oblique scar

1.5 cm decrease in the circumference of the right thigh and leg as compared with the normal left side. This indicates that there was noticeable muscle wastage on the right thigh due to lack of activities.
not able to sleep well; suffer from irritable mood; depression and anxiety and cannot control his temper; low self-esteem and self-image due to his reduced work capacity

treatments_received: repair of torn muscles by suturing
right ankle orthosis for the protection of muscle repair
discharged with short leg splint (worn for about 2 to 3 months)
use of 2 crutches for walking until end of December 2010
follow up treatment at the Department of Orthopaedics and Traumatology of PMH until 20 April 2011
10 sessions of physiotherapy at the out-patient clinic at PMH (magnetopause therapy, ultrasound therapy, ankle mobilizing and strengthening exercise and walking exercise)
occupational therapy out-patient service for work capacity evaluation
treatments_future: physiotherapy (15 to 20 sessions as suggested by Dr Chiang)

losses.description: residual weakness and numbness over his right leg
some reduction in the endurance for continuous and prolonged heavy manual work activities, as well as unduly prolonged walking and standing
plaintiff will suffer a disadvantage in the open labour market as a result of the injuries sustained by him in the accident
not able to sleep well; suffer from irritable mood; depression and anxiety and cannot control his temper; low self-esteem and self-image due to his reduced work capacity
